name: tlive
tagline_zh: 人在外，审批不急？用 tlive 在 Telegram/飞书/网页上实时批准，还能开个活终端，像在机房现场一样操作。
tagline_en: Approve from anywhere via Telegram/Feishu/web, plus a live terminal—like being at the server, minus the commute.
desc_en: tlive — remote approvals (Telegram/Feishu/web), live web terminal, and
why_zh: 同类工具只发通知，它却把审批和终端搬进聊天框，操作不跳转，响应快一步。
why_en: Others just notify; tlive embeds approvals and a live shell in chat, so you act without switching apps.
